title: Visual-feature hierarchy in mental imagery
disposition_reason: Only a legacy registration manifest for an unscored650-context programme is delivered in this task directory. It points to absent controller/private-grader source. Keep the full13-family×10-ROI scope and bind a real hierarchy scorer before claiming an executable known-answer investigation.

scientific_target.question: Does the difference in imagery feature recovery between cnn7 and cnn1 differ between high-level and low-level visual ROIs, after perception-trained decoding and matched feature-unit controls?
scientific_target.known_answer: A signed per-participant ROI×feature-layer interaction recomputed from frozen decoded imagery features and held category feature targets; null/adverse interactions are valid. There is no known universal hierarchy label supplied by the paper.
scientific_target.answer_origin: Measured within-person imagery fMRI and fixed pretrained category-feature bank; feature-correlation aggregation requires recovery and verification of the absent original grader.
scientific_target.case_unit: Participant×ROI×feature-family context, containing all imagery and perception rows.
scientific_target.independent_unit: Five biological participants; ROI,feature family, units,categories and repeated trials are dependent within person.
scientific_target.inference_scope: Association of perception-trained decoded category-related features with instructed imagery. The prospective contrast uses existing HVC/LVC and cnn7/cnn1 cells while retaining the complete 650-context companion matrix.
exclusions: No causal or temporal hierarchy, cue-free imagery, raw-BOLD interpretation, unseen-person generalization or reconstructed photograph.
An unscored complete output collection, manifest pin or process isolation is not a feature-recovery result.

inputs: Proposed full within-person processed perception/imagery fMRI:10 ROIs and13 feature families with1000 matched units per family.
1200 training rows,1750 perception rows and500 imagery rows per context; maximum316 training-selected voxels as stated in retained manifest.
forbidden_inputs: Imagery target-category labels and target-informed voxel,ROI,layer/unit selection.
Private grader outputs or category-bank correlations used to choose a favorable hierarchy contrast after seeing results.
observation_contract.case_identity: Retained manifest declares5 people × 10 ROIs × 13 families = 650 contexts. It supplies no executable local identity/array loader or scored authentic corpus; exact case bindings remain unresolved.
observation_contract.split: Within-person perception-trained transfer to blinded imagery; category/run/repetition grouping and train-only voxel selection required. New-person and imagery-trained fitting are excluded. Concrete source split/row manifests require verification with recovered producer.
observation_contract.coverage: All650 contexts retained, including cnn1..cnn8,hmax1..hmax3,gist,sift and V1,V2,V3,V4,LOC,FFA,PPA,LVC,HVC,VC. The four-cell prospective primary does not authorize dropping the other646 contexts or counting conditions as new benchmarks.

primary.name: Prospective HVC-versus-LVC interaction of cnn7-minus-cnn1 signed imagery feature correlation
primary.aggregation: For each participant D=[r(HVC,cnn7)-r(HVC,cnn1)]-[r(LVC,cnn7)-r(LVC,cnn1)]; report equal-five-participant mean and all five values. Freeze the source-compatible category/unit correlation aggregation before outputs; its absent implementation currently blocks scoring.
primary.rationale: Turns a broad hierarchy narrative into a falsifiable signed interaction while requiring matched units and preserving full-panel companions. The direction is not assumed from paper narrative.

secondary: Complete13-family×10-ROI feature-correlation/rank matrix and all participant values.
Perception-to-imagery transfer, category-only/no-neural and training-association-permuted controls.
Prespecified contrasts controlling category-bank similarity and matched 1000-unit representation; expose undefined constant correlations.

comparators.name: Perception-trained decoder
comparators.inputs: Same allowed perception support and1000-unit target family
comparators.procedure: Required fixed train-only voxel/decoder recipe across ROIs; source controller/scorer must be recovered and inspected.

comparators.name: Category-bank/no-neural reference
comparators.inputs: Candidate category feature bank without imagery neural observations
comparators.procedure: Required control for priors and feature-bank geometry; proposed, no local grader implements it.

comparators.name: Training-permuted decoder
comparators.inputs: Same feature dimensions and neural observations with frozen training-label permutation
comparators.procedure: Required negative control to distinguish genuine learned mapping from feature/category structure; proposed pending source binding.

nuisance_controls: Match feature units and training-only voxel selection across families/ROIs; no imagery-informed layer choice.
Hold category-name cues and category bank fixed; decoded category features do not establish subjective image contents.
Freeze every primary/secondary contrast before protected outcomes; full650 panel remains visible for coverage.
evaluation.uncertainty: Five-participant paired effects with explicit category/ROI/family dependence; no unit-level pseudoreplication. Primary two-sided inference and multiplicity must be selected before execution; none is implemented or claimed here.
evaluation.failure_policy: No metric from an unscored completion. Future scorer must validate all 650 contexts and complete rows before target reads, retain failures/undefined correlations and refuse favorable subset aggregation.

implementation.scorer_target: No target-consuming scorer is present. Manifest explicitly declares metric_computed=false, one_complete 650_collection_unscored, private_grading_performed=false and separate future grading.
implementation.delivered_scope: Registration metadata only, with unavailable referenced historical controller/grader paths; source manifest is not an executable implementation.
missing: Recover and verify actual producer/loader/grader source and exact category/unit Pearson/rank formulas.
Bind prospective primary hierarchy interaction, all 650 companions, comparator controls, native data and protected execution.
implementation.execution_evidence: Manifest status not_run and scientific/runtime qualification false; no scientific score computed. No new execution in this revision.

direct_observation.boundary: Single map/plot interpretation would be a different endpoint unless independently specified.

tool_assisted.boundary: Must freeze effects and predictions before grader access; independent scorer verifies numerical claims.
